subject: MAP: Final ramp sync, runbook items, and fallback roster
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@pulseiq.com>, launch@pulseiq.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Final ramp sync, runbook items, and fallback roster

Team / Alex,

This is our weekly MAP checkpoint focused on the final ramp and go-live coordination. We have one week to go before the planned launch window (target: 2026-10-31 10:00 UTC). Important callouts and asks below — please read and confirm owners for any open items by EOD PT Monday.

High-level status:
- MAP health: amber — majority of infra & QA tasks progressing; a couple of outstanding test cases in traffic shaping.
- Risk: rollback trigger points not yet instrumented on PulseIQ side (item 5).
- Blocker: DocuSign counter-signature pending for the SLA addendum (Ben).

Action items (owners & current status):
1) Final runbook review and cutover timings — owner: Ben Carter — In progress. See attached runbook_v3.pdf.
2) Thorough soak test (12h) on staging with production-like traffic — owner: Karthik Iyer — Scheduled for Wed (10/27) 22:00 UTC.
3) KV cache warm-up plan for first 2 hours — owner: Laura Bennett — Drafted, needs validation by PulseIQ.
4) Monitoring dashboards & alert thresholds — owner: Irene Choi — alerts created; ops escalation chain in runbook.
5) Rollback gating and automation hooks — owner: PulseIQ (Alex) — need confirmation that feature-flag rollback is validated and that we have a tested fallback image.
6) Contract addendum sign-off (SLA window) — owner: Ben Carter — awaiting counter-signature from PulseIQ legal.

Meeting: weekly MAP sync tomorrow (Mon) 8:00 PT / 15:00 UTC — 30 minutes. Please have owner updates ready as bullets.

Attachments included: runbook_v3.pdf, cutover-checklist.xlsx, fallback-roster.csv

If PulseIQ can confirm the rollback gating plan (item 5) by EOD Monday, we can move to green and lock the 10/31 window.

Thanks,
Irene

--
Irene Choi
Senior Strategic Customer Manager | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Alex Mercer <alex@pulseiq.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Final ramp sync, runbook items, and fallback roster

Thanks Irene — quick owner updates and clarifications: 

1) Runbook: I completed a pass on the sequence-of-steps for cutover and added an explicit step to validate DB connection limits (see runbook_v3.pdf, page 11). I flagged the decision point at +30m (post-launch) where we either continue or trigger rollback.
2) DocuSign: I pushed the SLA addendum to PulseIQ legal this morning (link: https://www.docusign.com/12345/DEAL-8819-signature). Awaiting their counter-signature; if we don't get it by Tue noon PT we'll need a manual approval path.
3) Cutover timing: I recommend a 2-hour maintenance window starting 10/31 10:00 UTC with a 30-minute pre-check and 60-minute monitoring hold before declaring success. That gives room for the KV warm-up and traffic ramp.
4) Fallback roster: Uploaded fallback-roster.csv — includes two standby engineers from Redwood and the phone tree.

Open asks for PulseIQ: please confirm the feature-flag rollback mechanism (automatable via your CI) and the final test window for soak (Karthik will run on Wed night). Also confirm that you can provide a signed SLA addendum by Tue noon PT or agree on the manual approval fallback.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0128

From: Alex Mercer <alex@pulseiq.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: launch@pulseiq.com
Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2026 17:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP: Final ramp sync, runbook items, and fallback roster

Thanks Irene and Ben — appreciate the clear list. Quick answers from PulseIQ side:

- Rollback gating: confirmed. We have a feature-flag rollback that reverts traffic to the previous image and disables new inference paths. Engineering will run a dry run of the rollback in staging on Tue 10/27 02:00 UTC and share logs. We will also expose an endpoint for the automation hook (details to follow).
- Soak test: Wed 10/27 22:00 UTC looks good for us. We'll provide synthetic traffic profile and a short runbook for our side of the test.
- SLA addendum: Legal tentatively approved; counter-sign expected by Mon EOD PT. If delayed, we can accept exec-level written approval for the first 14 days and follow up with the signature.

One small ask: can we shift the cutover start to 10/31 11:00 UTC instead of 10:00? We prefer to allow an extra hour to coordinate a vendor maintenance that morning. If Redwood can shift, PulseIQ will confirm today and proceed with the rollback dry run schedule above.

Subject: Re: MAP: Final ramp sync, runbook items, and fallback roster

Alex — shifting the cutover to 11:00 UTC on 10/31 is fine. We'll update the runbook and cutover-checklist.xlsx to reflect the 11:00 start and add a note for the extra coordination hour. Ben — please update page 3 and the timeline slide with the +1h shift.

Next steps summary: 
- PulseIQ: run rollback dry run Tue 10/27 02:00 UTC (please share results).
- Karthik: execute soak Wed 10/27 22:00 UTC.
- Ben: update runbook & slide deck for 11:00 start; re-upload final runbook_v3.pdf by Mon 18:00 PT.
- Irene: prepare customer-facing go/no-go checklist and publish to the Drive folder.

I'll send a short standing reminder 24h before cutover with final readiness checks. Good momentum — thanks all.

Irene
